description: Generate spoken audio from text using ElevenLabs voices via Runway. 49 voice presets available. Can also use custom voice IDs (eleven_multilingual_v2 and eleven_v4). MODELS: eleven_multilingual_v2 (default), eleven_v3 (expressive; supports audio tags like [laughs] and [whispers] in the text; preset voices only), eleven_v4 (newest and most expressive; audio tags like [laughs], [whispers] and [pause]; up to 2500 characters). COST: 1 credit per 50 characters (eleven_v4: 5 credits per 1000). WORKFLOW: Returns task_id → poll or use wait_for_runway_task.

text.description: Text to speak. Max 1000 characters (5000 for eleven_v3 and 2500 for eleven_v4, which also accept audio tags like [laughs]).

voice.description: Voice preset name or custom voice UUID (custom voices need eleven_multilingual_v2 or eleven_v4). Default: Maya.

name: generate_speech
